graph_team_stat_cfb_def_epa_per_play.description: CFB cross-league replication of the NFL graph team_stat arm, cell def_epa_per_play (stands in for the NFL def_yards_per_play cell; CFB has no yards-per-play column). Primary comparison: the frozen XLG-03 CFB market-residual benchmark arm (CFB_MODEL_FEATURE_COLUMNS, ridge alpha 10, 500-game training floor) versus the same arm plus one column, the signed-Katz differential of def_epa_per_play propagated over the CFB schedule graph at the NFL-frozen structure (alpha 0.85, half_life 8.0, max_row_l1 1.0, prior_weight 1.0, min_games 16, signed_katz, injury_beta 0.0). Graded at the benchmark own spread_line, XLG-03 clean core 2012-2019+2021-2025, walk-forward weekly refit. The raw diff_def_epa_per_play is ALREADY in the reference arm, so the graph is never credited for what the raw statistic earned. Benchmark accuracy 51.5952 pct, candidate 51.5840 pct.
graph_team_stat_cfb_def_epa_per_play.notes:
Instrument checks ran first and both passed. Null (200 within-week permutations, close grade): mean -0.005 pts, sd 0.140, 95% [-0.269,+0.280] -- centred on zero. Positive control (graph column replaced by realised ats_margin): +48.405 pts, week-blocked P+ 1.000, 95% [+47.374,+49.464], 100th percentile of its own null -- the instrument is not blind, though it is NOT proven able to resolve a 0.2-point effect, so positive_control_bound is inadmissible and this stays unresolved_below_power. Season-blocked secondary: -0.178 to +0.158, P+ 0.425. Opener-graded secondary (spread_open, n=8925): +0.056 pts, P+ 0.667, 95% [-0.210,+0.316]. Observed delta sits at the 47.5th percentile of its own permutation null. Era magnitudes (report only, close grade): 2012-2019 +0.075 pts P+ 0.632 n=5349; 2021-2025 -0.140 pts P+ 0.168 n=3584. Power: the two arms disagree on only 175 of 9093 picks (1.92 pct), which is why the interval is +-0.29 pts rather than the +-2.6 pts of the NFL on-production reading. Secondary comparisons on the same rows: graph_only minus raw_only +0.369 pts P+ 0.798 (this is the NFL bare-baseline direction, and it replicates); graph_only minus market +1.052 pts P+ 0.896 -- but note the CFB market arm picks home on 92.5 pct of games because CFB spread odds are flat -110/-110, so that comparator is near-always-home and is the weakest of the three. Not pooled with its two sibling cells: they share the same window and overlapping football.

graph_team_stat_cfb_off_success_rate.description: CFB cross-league replication of the NFL graph team_stat arm, cell off_success_rate. NOT a counterpart to the NFL off_sack_rate cell -- the CFB feature table carries no sack or pressure column at all, so off_sack_rate has no CFB analogue; off_success_rate was predeclared as the third-best available team-stat column (nearest NFL sibling pbp_off_success_rate). Primary comparison: the frozen XLG-03 CFB market-residual benchmark arm (CFB_MODEL_FEATURE_COLUMNS, ridge alpha 10, 500-game training floor) versus the same arm plus one column, the signed-Katz differential of off_success_rate propagated over the CFB schedule graph at the NFL-frozen structure (alpha 0.85, half_life 8.0, max_row_l1 1.0, prior_weight 1.0, min_games 16, signed_katz, injury_beta 0.0). Graded at the benchmark own spread_line, XLG-03 clean core 2012-2019+2021-2025. The raw diff_off_success_rate is ALREADY in the reference arm. Benchmark accuracy 51.5952 pct, candidate 51.4161 pct.
